name: Casa Costalita
description:
Casa Costalita is a bright and welcoming apartment located within the sought-after Costalita community on Estepona’s New Golden Mile. Surrounded by beautifully maintained tropical gardens and just a 5-minute walk from Costalita Beach, it offers the perfect setting for a relaxing stay on the Costa del Sol.

The property comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests and features 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The open-plan living and dining area creates a spacious and comfortable atmosphere, while large windows allow natural light to fill the apartment throughout the day.

One of the highlights of the property is its private terrace overlooking the community’s stunning gardens and swimming pool. Surrounded by mature palm trees and lush greenery, it provides the perfect space to enjoy breakfast outdoors, unwind with a book or simply take in the peaceful surroundings.

Guests also have access to the beautifully maintained communal swimming pool and landscaped gardens, creating a resort-like atmosphere throughout the year.

The beach can be reached within just a few minutes on foot, while restaurants, cafés, supermarkets and other local amenities are all conveniently located nearby. Several golf courses, including El Paraíso Golf Club, are also just a short drive away.

Ideally located between Estepona and Marbella, Casa Costalita combines comfort, convenience and an excellent location, making it an ideal choice for families, couples and longer stays alike.

* Explore the Surroundings

Beyond the tranquillity of Costalita, the property is perfectly positioned for exploring some of the Costa del Sol’s most popular destinations.

• Relax on the beaches of the New Golden Mile

• Discover the restaurants and cafés of Cancelada

• Explore Estepona’s charming Old Town and marina

• Enjoy golf at nearby courses including El Paraíso Golf Club

• Visit Puerto Banús and Marbella

• Experience Málaga’s culture, museums and gastronomy

• Explore the white villages of Andalucía

• Take a day trip to Gibraltar

Please note that we welcome families and couples only, no groups under 30, and no hen or stag parties. Should you fall outside of this category but wish to book nonetheless, please send us an enquiry detailing a bit more about yourself and the group that you will be travelling with so we can request this for you.

Don’t forget to ask about our concierge service! We look forward to welcoming you.
